{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == 999999.99]

# Confirm QA orders are marked as 'completed'
qa_completed = qa_orders[qa_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Final count: completed orders excluding QA
completed_actual = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue'] != 999999.99)]
completed_actual_count = len(completed_actual)

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Total rows in data: {len(data)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders that are completed: {len(qa_completed)}")
print(f"Number of actual completed orders (excluding QA): {completed_actual_count}")

completed_actual_count"}
